new foundry.applications.api.DialogV2({ window: { title: "Gain Stress" }, classes: ["macro-popup-dialog"], position: { width: 600 }, content: `

Gain Stress

You gain 1 Stress every time you fail a Stat Check or Save. Occasionally, certain locations or entities can automatically give you Stress from interacting with or witnessing them. Your Minimum Stress starts at 2, and the Maximum Stress you can have is 20. Any Stress you take over 20 instead reduces the most relevant Stat or Save by that amount.
Select your modification:
`, buttons: [ { label: `Gain 1 Stress`, action: 'one', icon: `fas fa-angle-up`, callback: () => game.mothershiprpg.modify('system.other.stress.value', { kind: 'amount', amount: 1 }) }, { label: `Gain 2 Stress`, action: 'two', icon: `fas fa-angle-double-up`, callback: () => game.mothershiprpg.modify('system.other.stress.value', { kind: 'amount', amount: 2 }) }, { label: `Gain 1d5 Stress`, action: 'roll', icon: `fas fa-arrow-circle-up`, callback: () => game.mothershiprpg.modify('system.other.stress.value', { kind: 'roll', dice: '1d5' }) } ] }).render({ force: true });
name: Gain Stress
